battle: Hey kid! What are you doing here?
Silph Co. will be merged with Team Rocket!
Team Rocket has taken command of Silph Co.!
Fwahahaha! My boss has been after this place!
How did you know I was a Rocket?
I work for both Silph and Team Rocket!

lines: Oh, you're not with Team Rocket. I'm sorry, I thought...
reward: I'm sorry. Here, please take this!
Thunder Wave paralyzes the target Pokémon. It may be unable to move in battle.

battle: I support Team Rocket more than Silph!
Humph... Team Rocket said if I helped, they'd let me study Pokémon!
I better tell the boss on 7F!
Whaaat? There shouldn't be any children here?
It's not smart to pick a fight with Team Rocket!
We study Poké Ball technology on this floor!
We worked on the ultimate Poké Ball that can catch anything!

lines: Team Rocket was after the Master Ball, which can catch any Pokémon!

battle: Are you satisfied with beating me? Then go on home!
Stop right there! Don't you move!
So, you want to see my boss?

lines: What kept you? Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here!
I guess Team Rocket slowed you down! Not that I care!
battle: I saw you in Saffron, so I decided to see if you got better!
Oh ho! So you are ready for the boss!
Well! I'm heading to the Pokémon League to kick out the Elite Four! I'll become the world's most powerful trainer! Smell ya!

lines: Oh! Hi! You're not with Team Rocket!
You came to save us? Why, thank you!
reward: I want you to have this Pokémon for saving us.
It's Lapras. It's very intelligent and will be much better off with you!

lines: Ah! So we meet again! The president and I are discussing a vital business proposition.
battle: Keep your nose out of grown-up matters... Or, experience a world of pain!
Blast it all! You ruined our plans for Silph! But Team Rocket will never fall! Never forget that all Pokémon exist for Team Rocket!
